title: Review prescription-drug trading-partner and tracing conditions
normalized_text: A qualified reviewer would determine which DSCSA product-tracing, verification, and authorized-trading-partner requirements apply to the identified prescription-drug distribution transaction.

citations.notes: Source fixture distinguishes supply-chain transactions from patient-specific dispensing.

actions: determine transaction scope and retain required tracing evidence when applicable
conditions: when the transaction is within the statutory product and trading-partner definitions
notes: Not a conclusion that a particular transaction is covered, compliant, or authorized.
